description: Checks a factual claim in an operator-supplied news item against the excerpts cited beside it, one claim at a time. Ported from the production question in DansiDanutz/fake-real-jev (lib/claim-check.js), reshaped to this repository's spec schema: its `criteria` map becomes an `options` list, and its `unknown` relation becomes the abstain option.

appliesTo.origin: port of a production question, not a validated instrument of this repository
appliesTo.state: the operator's own message carries the claim and the cited excerpts
